notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for RTIambassador::getDimensionHandleSet on a standard two-dimensional region created from distinct adapter-selected model dimensions, its successful HLAreportServiceInvocation, and the InvalidRegion exception for a default-constructed RegionHandle while service reporting is disabled. The returned dimension set maps to IEEE 1516.1-2025 §10.26 using RL-424's source-backed crosswalk correction rather than the Lab-exported §10.25.6; region setup maps to §9.1.2, and successful report content maps only to the asserted clauses 11.5 and 11.5.1 fields. The exception is an official API contract check and is not assigned a separate Lab requirement row. Federation setup reuses the existing federation execution API contract. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimensions, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies the queried two-handle dimension set and all eight standard report parameters, including the inherited HLAfederate reporter identity, supplied region handle, corresponding returned dimension-set text, service classification, reliable delivery, success/exception state, and serial. It performs no region-based subscription, publication, update, interaction routing, or provider-specific inspection.
